conditions: Classical monatomic ideal gas in equilibrium with only translational degrees of freedom contributing; internal energy reference chosen accordingly.

evidence: Classical equipartition assigns mean energy k_B T/2 to each of the three translational quadratic degrees of freedom per particle. Multiply by N=n N_A and use R=N_A k_B, with other internal contributions absent or excluded by the reference convention.
